items.title: Inserting a short chord at the same position preserves Knuth equivalence of matchings
items.author: Avichai Marmor
items.work: Schur-positivity of short chords in matchings
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled lemma at source lines 1167-1170: if two matchings of the same size are Knuth equivalent, then inserting a short chord at the same index in both gives Knuth equivalent matchings again. The proof (source lines 1172-1176) needs two reductions that the statement does not show: first the position of the insertion has to be normalised to the last one, which uses the independently proved invariance of the insertion position, and then the number of elementary Knuth transformations joining the two matchings has to be reduced by induction, leaving the case of a single elementary transformation, which is checked against the explicit vertex-shifting formula of the insertion.
